page.overview:
Who is Siriondil?

Siriondil was the eleventh King of Gondor.

Siriondil became King of Gondor in TA 748 after the death of his father Atanatar I. He had two sons, Tarannon and Tarciryan. His reign was without notable events and probably peaceful. He ruled for eighty-two years and died in TA 830 at the age of two-hundred and sixty years of age and was succeeded by his son, Tarannon.

The name Siriondil probably meant 'River- lover' or 'River-friend' in Quenya.
